title: Record health samples in serve, where the server is given a Runtime
goal: The live service records a local health sample every minute and the dashboard shows it
acceptance: Failing test first: a server given a real Runtime records samples that /api/health/metrics returns
A failed sample never stops the service
The live dashboard shows a Service sample after the update
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Fixed 2026-11-23 from the owner question on the live dashboard.
